messages.author: 89abf8a3796a510b
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stan-dev/math: fvar testing
parts:
Most, if not all, scalar and matrix functions are tested with fvar<var> and fvar<fvar<var> > for:

 - valid values
 - invalid values
 - nan values
 - invalid arguments
 - gradients equal expected values
 - function values equal expected values

Most scalar functions and some matrix functions are tested with fvar<var> and fvar<fvar<var> > for:

 - diagonals of hessians vs. expected values
 - diagonals of gradients of hessians vs. expected values

Few, if any, scalar and matrix functions are tested with fvar<var> and fvar<var<var> > for:

 - Full Hessians vs. expected values (and/or finite diff)
 - Gradients of the Hessians vs. expected values (and/or finite diff)

It also looks as if the unit tests in test/unit/math/mix/mat/prob are very sparse and test only that function values equal expected values.

If you need a more full accounting of test inventory, let me know and I/we can write up a file-by-file description.

Rob
